description: Read one Arkansas Supreme Court or Court of Appeals opinion by its neutral citation ("2026 Ark. 140", "2026 Ark. App. 449") or archive item id: case name, decision date, docket, author, disposition, the full opinion text, its citation status, and its version history (every editorial revision the court published, each with retrieval time and SHA-256). From the Arkansas Judiciary's official opinions archive, decisions from 2026-01-01 on. For older Arkansas citations use court-listener lookup_citation.

citation.description: Arkansas neutral citation, e.g. "2026 Ark. 140" or "2026 Ark. App. 449".

item_id.description: Archive item id (from ark_recent_opinions or ark_search_opinions), used when there is no citation.

max_chars.description: Truncate the returned text to this many characters (default 40000, max 200000).

version.description: Return this earlier version's text instead of the current one (see versions[]).

name: ark_opinion
title: Ark Opinion
